title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-007
doc_notes: This document is a translated personal statement by Captain Kenju Terauchi regarding the JAL Flight 1628 UAP encounter, received by the FAA in 1987.

incidents.summary: Japan Airlines Flight 1628 encountered two smaller unidentified craft and a large mother ship over Alaska.
incidents.explanation: The document provides a personal account of the sighting without offering a formal government explanation.
incidents.location_name: Alaska, near Ft. Yukon and Talkeetna
incidents.quote: two spaceships stopped in front of our face, shooting off lights
